title: The delta materializer skips fenced examples when it matches a requirement block
description: The delta materializer skips fenced examples when it matches a requirement block
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the materializer match REQ-change-152, which has it match a block by the shared requirement-heading reader; that reader treats a fenced example as quoted text, never a requirement. The change spec only lists the new test file.
acceptance_criteria: A MODIFIED delta for a requirement whose header also appears in a fenced example above it replaces the real block and keeps the example byte for byte; a heading inside a fenced example within the real block does not end the block (red then green)
